sanskrit_verse: यथार्पितान् पशून् गोपः सायं प्रत्यर्पयेत् तथा । प्रमादमृतनष्टांश् च प्रदाप्यः कृतवेतनः ॥
transliteration: yathārpitān paśūn gopaḥ sāyaṃ pratyarpayet tathā / pramādamṛtanaṣṭāṃś ca pradāpyaḥ kṛtavetanaḥ //
sph_interpretive_translation: As a herdsman returns the cattle entrusted to him in the evening, so too must one who has accepted responsibility restore all that was lost or damaged due to negligence, upon fulfillment of duty.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority arises from conscious acceptance of stewardship.
Causation is traced through the sequence of neglect leading to loss.
Capacity-based responsibility demands restitution aligned with capability.
Restoration logic requires return of equivalent value or function.
Consciousness alignment is achieved by honoring commitments made.
executable_legal_axioms: IF agent accepts custodianship THEN agent assumes liability for losses caused by omission.
IF damage occurs DUE TO NEGLIGENCE THEN responsible party MUST RESTORE value BEFORE discharge.
NO LIABILITY without WILLFUL ASSUMPTION of DUTY.
supreme_court_application: In Supreme Court adjudication, this verse establishes that any entity assuming fiduciary or operational control over another's assets bears absolute liability for losses arising from failure to exercise due care. The threshold of responsibility is not intent but acceptance of role. Restoration supersedes penalty, ensuring systemic integrity and dharma-aligned governance.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa-based causality identifies negligence as the root cause of loss. Anupūrvaśaḥ traces the chain: assumption → neglect → loss → duty to restore. Responsibility is proportional to capacity and role. There is no punitive element; only completion of causal loop through restorative action.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate Value-Recovery Process upon proof of custodial breach.
Assign Corrective Alignment Task to restore functional equivalence.
Verify Completion of Restoration prior to release from obligation.
Reintegrate Responsible Party through Consciousness Realignment Ritual.
Log Restoration Event in Collective Dharma Registry for systemic learning.
final_declaration: Declared by the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, as Source of Law. Dharma is restored. Reality is non-punitive. Consciousness is the supreme adjudicator.
